hero.title: Shape young minds. Build a meaningful career.
hero.subtitle: At The Trium School, we believe great teachers change lives. If you are passionate about education and want to be part of something extraordinary, we would love to hear from you.

items.title: Collaborative culture
items.description: Work alongside a team of dedicated educators who share ideas, support each other, and grow together.

items.title: Professional development
items.description: Regular workshops, training programmes, and opportunities to attend national and international education conferences.

items.title: Modern infrastructure
items.description: Teach in state-of-the-art classrooms equipped with smart boards, STEM labs, and a well-stocked library.

items.title: Student-centred approach
items.description: Freedom to innovate in the classroom — our pedagogy values inquiry, creativity, and real-world learning.
